data.title: Tamper-Proof Payment Gateway Callbacks
data.summary: Payment webhooks are public URLs. Anyone can POST to them. Every callback is verified with an HMAC-SHA256 signature and processed inside a PostgreSQL row lock, so forged or double-clicked confirmations can never mark an unpaid order as paid.
data.pipeline: Gateway Webhook → HMAC Verify → PostgreSQL Lock

data.title: Swiss Classified-Ads Marketplace Upgrade
data.summary: A production Swiss classified-ads platform moved from Laravel 10 to Laravel 13 in about two weeks: dependency audit first, staged upgrades, then PayPal checkout finalized without dropping live listings or payments.
data.pipeline: Laravel 10 Legacy → Dependency Audit → Laravel 13 + PayPal

data.title: ERP Module Suite Protected by Pest Tests
data.summary: Quotations with revision history, budget plans (RAB), contract lifecycle, and progress-billing (termin) invoices for an internal ERP. Every money-moving transition is covered by Pest tests, so a refactor can never silently change what a client owes.
data.metric_label: Automated tests on every billing flow
data.pipeline: Quotation & Budget → Contracts → Progress Billing + Pest

data.title: Reusable API Library, Gov Sync & Face Recognition
data.summary: One reusable Laravel API library now powers 3+ projects: government-platform sync with retry-safe connectors, plus AWS Rekognition face matching, all answering in under 3 seconds on a small 1GB server.
data.metric_label: One SDK, three-plus projects, under 3 seconds
data.pipeline: Reusable API SDK → Gov Platform Sync → Face Recognition

data.title: Callback Gateway Pembayaran Anti-Palsu
data.summary: Webhook pembayaran adalah URL publik. Siapa pun bisa POST ke sana. Setiap callback diverifikasi dengan tanda tangan HMAC-SHA256 dan diproses di dalam row lock PostgreSQL, sehingga konfirmasi palsu atau klik-ganda tak pernah bisa menandai order.
data.pipeline: Webhook Gateway → Verifikasi HMAC → Kunci PostgreSQL
